parts.question: German AX-17 guidance before latest revision?

result.answer: Before the latest revision, German guidance for AX-17 was provided by DE-AX17-LBL-038, which was in effect from 03-Feb-2025 to 15-Sep-2026 and is now superseded [E2, E3]. This historical guidance stated that for moderate renal impairment, the starting dose was 50 mg once daily (OD) [E2, E3]. For normal and mild renal categories, the historical starting dose was also 50 mg OD [E2]. For severe renal impairment, AX-17 was not recommended [E2].
